claims.text: Contract award notices 676246-2026 and 677429-2026 (European Commission, DG CNECT) settle lots of a call for tenders — project EC-CNECT/2026/OP/0003, contract folder f7277ac5-6cb0-4d0a-876d-3e2e5e054bcd — that was already published as contract notice 115144-2026 on 2026-02-17, over seven months before the award notices entered the sentinel's envelope.

European Commission, DG CNECT (Communications Networks, Content and Technology) published at least 27 TED notices mentioning 'artificial intelligence' between 2024-08-06 and 2026-10-01, spanning at least five distinct thematic procurement lines (AI Act implementation assistance, AI Act safety technical assistance, DSA/AI Act multilingual chatbots, 'AI for Public Good', 'Digital Twin for Reconstruction', 'Digital Transformation Accelerator'), i.e. a sustained multi-year AI-related procurement activity rather than a single purchase.

'AI for Public Good' (Lot 1 Health: AI-based cancer imaging for breast/prostate diagnosis; Lot 2 Energy: AI-based electric grid optimisation) was run as two separate procurement procedures under distinct contract folders, EC-CNECT/2024/OP/0094 (contract notice 484917-2025, published 2025-07-24) and EC-CNECT/2026/OP/0003 (contract notice 115144-2026, published 2026-02-18), with an identical estimated overall budget of EUR 5,400,000 (EUR 2,400,000 Lot 1 / EUR 3,000,000 Lot 2) in both editions.

Lot 1 (Health) of the first 'AI for Public Good' edition (EC-CNECT/2024/OP/0094) received 11 electronic submissions but closed without a contract being awarded (winner-selection-status 'clos-nw', non-award-justification code 'other'), per contract award notice 762241-2025 (award date 2025-11-10).

Lot 1 (Health) of the second 'AI for Public Good' edition (EC-CNECT/2026/OP/0003) — the same lot that closed without a winner in the first edition — was awarded on 2026-09-04 for EUR 2,060,727.30 to a consortium including FBG and Fundacao Champalimaud, per contract award notice 677429-2026.

Lot 2 (Energy) of the second 'AI for Public Good' edition (EC-CNECT/2026/OP/0003) was awarded on 2026-08-25 for EUR 2,711,670 to a consortium led by INESC TEC, funded under the Horizon Europe programme (HORIZONEU).
